summary.zh: 基于 6 大动机类别与 12 个细分维度的玩家数据采集量表。填写完成后即时生成 12 维内驱力雷达图，并支持一键导出 CSV 与雷达图 PNG。
summary.en: A 42-item player research questionnaire covering 6 motivation categories and 12 dimensions. Generates an instant 12-axis radar chart with one-click CSV and PNG export.

hint.zh: 请联系研究者获取本次调研的参与密钥。
hint.en: Please contact the researcher for the participant access key.

description.zh: 用于对后续 12 维度内驱力数据进行设备、平台与游玩时长分组。
description.en: Used to group motivation scores by input device, platform, playtime, and demographics.

text.zh: 习惯使用的输入设备（多选）
text.en: Preferred input device(s) (Select all that apply)

text.en: Gaming platform(s) you play on (Select all that apply)

text.en: Average playtime every two weeks over the past two months

text.zh: 年纪
text.en: Age group

text.zh: 性别
text.en: Gender

text.zh: 以下的所有问题都请在看到问题的第一时间做出一个感性的判断（1 = 非常不符合，5 = 非常符合）。
text.en: For all following statements, please make an intuitive judgment based on your immediate reaction (1 = Strongly disagree, 5 = Strongly agree).

label.zh: 我已了解作答规则，开始凭直觉作答
label.en: I understand the guidelines and am ready to answer intuitively

title.zh: 一、解脱 · 感官刺激与逻辑解谜（Q07–Q12）

text.zh: 我喜欢节奏极快、高风险且让人肾上腺素飙升的游戏体验（如极限躲避、高速竞速或紧张的战斗）。
text.en: I enjoy fast-paced, high-stakes gameplay that gives an adrenaline rush (such as tight dodging, high-speed racing, or intense combat).

text.zh: 华丽的视听演出、强烈的打击感以及爽快的即时反馈，是吸引我玩下去的重要原因。
text.en: Flashy visuals and audio, strong hit impact, and snappy instant feedback are major reasons I keep playing.

text.zh: 玩游戏时，我非常看重那种能让我全神贯注、心跳加速的感官刺激。
text.en: When playing games, I strongly value sensory excitement that keeps me fully locked in and gets my heart racing.

text.zh: 我很享受通过观察环境、分析机制或逻辑推理来破解谜题的过程。
text.en: I enjoy solving puzzles by observing the environment, analyzing mechanics, or using logical reasoning.

text.zh: 弄懂一套复杂的系统规则，并利用规则规律找到最优解，会给我带来极大的满足感。
text.en: Figuring out a complex set of rules and using them to find the optimal solution gives me great satisfaction.

text.zh: 相比于纯靠反应速度，我更喜欢需要动脑筋思考、“灵光一现”才能过关的玩法。
text.en: Compared to pure reflexes, I prefer gameplay that challenges me to think and reward an 'aha' moment.

title.zh: 二、探险 · 收藏与发现（Q13–Q18）

text.zh: 看到图鉴、成就列表或背包里的空缺被一步步填满，会让我感到非常舒适和满足。
text.en: Seeing empty slots in a codex, achievement list, or inventory gradually filled in feels deeply satisfying to me.

text.zh: 我愿意为了获取一件稀有道具、限定外观或隐藏收集品而反复刷取或投入额外时间。
text.en: I am willing to grind or invest extra time to obtain a rare item, limited cosmetic, or hidden collectible.

text.zh: 在游戏中“拥有”大量独特物品或全收集的达成感，是我重要的游玩动力。
text.en: Owning a large collection of unique items or reaching 100% completion is a key motivator for me.

text.zh: 面对地图上的未探索区域或迷雾，我总有一种想去揭开它全貌的强烈冲动。
text.en: When I see unexplored areas or fog of war on a map, I feel a strong urge to uncover all of it.

text.zh: 我喜欢在主线任务之外四处闲逛，寻找开发者藏在角落里的彩蛋、支线或隐藏房间。
text.en: I enjoy wandering off the main path to look for easter eggs, side quests, or hidden rooms.

text.zh: 高自由度的探索体验和充满未知奇遇的游戏世界，比明确的线性指引更吸引我。
text.en: An open world full of unknown surprises appeals to me more than strict, linear guidance.

title.zh: 三、表现 · 个性化与角色代入（Q19–Q24）

text.zh: 我会在捏脸、角色穿搭、武器涂装或家园建造上花费大量时间，让它符合我的审美。
text.en: I spend a lot of time on character creation, outfits, weapon skins, or base building to match my personal taste.

text.zh: 即使某些外观或装饰品不提供任何数值加成，我也非常乐意去获取和搭配它们。
text.en: Even if cosmetics or decorations give zero stat bonuses, I still happily collect and style them.

text.zh: 我希望自己在游戏里的形象、流派配置或建造作品是独一无二、能体现个人风格的。
text.en: I want my in-game appearance, build, or creations to feel unique and reflect my personal style.

text.zh: 我很容易代入主角的身份，并随着剧情的起伏与游戏中的角色产生真实的情感共鸣。
text.en: I easily step into the protagonist's shoes and feel genuine emotional connection with the characters as the story unfolds.

text.zh: 宏大自洽的世界观设定、丰满的人物塑造以及动人的故事线，是我选择一款游戏的首要标准。
text.en: Cohesive worldbuilding, rich characters, and a moving story are my top criteria when choosing a game.

text.zh: 在面对剧情分支选择时，我倾向于遵循角色性格或内心的道德感去做决定，而不仅仅看奖励好坏。
text.en: When making narrative choices, I follow my character's personality or personal values rather than just picking the best reward.

title.zh: 四、管理 · 资源分配与战略规划（Q25–Q30）

text.zh: 我喜欢精打细算，在有限的金币、体力、行动点或背包空间中做出最划算的分配取舍。
text.en: I enjoy carefully budgeting limited gold, stamina, action points, or inventory space to make the most efficient trade-offs.

text.zh: 面对“强化 A 就会放弃 B”的短中期资源博弈时，权衡利弊并承担机会成本的过程让我觉得很有趣。
text.en: When upgrading A means giving up B in the short to medium term, weighing pros, cons, and opportunity cost feels fun to me.

text.zh: 我很享受通过合理的运营与资源周转，让手头的资源发挥出最大效益。
text.en: I enjoy managing economy and resource flow smoothly to squeeze maximum value out of what I have.

text.zh: 在游玩过程中，我习惯提前规划好中后期的科技树路线、养成顺序或全局发展蓝图。
text.en: While playing, I like planning my mid-to-late-game tech tree, build progression, or overall blueprint in advance.

text.zh: 我喜欢做长线布局，通过预判几步甚至几个阶段后的局势变化来建立优势。
text.en: I enjoy long-term positioning, anticipating how things will unfold several turns or stages ahead to gain an advantage.

text.zh: 看着自己提前制定的长期计划在游戏后期一步步兑现，会让我获得很强的掌控感。
text.en: Watching a long-term plan I set up early pay off step by step in the late game gives me a strong sense of control.

title.zh: 五、精通 · 里程碑与技巧精进（Q31–Q36）

text.zh: 打通一个高难度章节、升到满级或达到某个段位节点，会给我带来强烈的“阶段性胜利”快感。
text.en: Clearing a tough chapter, hitting max level, or reaching a ranked tier gives me a strong rush of milestone victory.

text.zh: 我喜欢有清晰目标指引和明确进度条的设计，每完成一个里程碑都会激励我继续推进。
text.en: I like clear objectives and visible progress bars; finishing each milestone motivates me to push further.

text.zh: 当遇到卡关时，一想到“只要过了这一关就能解锁新阶段 / 拿到通关勋章”，我就会更有动力坚持。
text.en: When stuck on a stage, knowing that beating it unlocks the next phase or earns a completion badge keeps me going.

text.zh: 我享受从“手忙脚乱”到“行云流水”的过程，愿意为了练好一个连招或技巧反复练习。
text.en: I enjoy progressing from clumsy to effortless execution and willingly practice repeatedly to master a combo or technique.

text.zh: 失败后，我喜欢复盘自己的操作失误或决策漏洞，并尝试在下一次做得更精准。
text.en: After a defeat, I like reviewing my mechanical mistakes or bad calls so I can execute more cleanly next time.

text.zh: 相比于靠数值碾压过关，我更喜欢凭借自身操作水平和意识的提升去战胜强敌。
text.en: Rather than out-statting enemies, I prefer beating tough foes by improving my own mechanics and game sense.

title.zh: 六、社交 · 竞争与合作（Q37–Q42）

text.zh: 在竞技对抗中击败对手、冲上排行榜前列，会让我感到非常兴奋和自豪。
text.en: Defeating opponents in competitive matches and climbing near the top of the leaderboard makes me feel excited and proud.

text.zh: 我会在意自己与好友或全服玩家之间的战绩、通关速度或练度对比。
text.en: I pay attention to how my match record, clear times, or progression compares against friends or the broader player base.

text.zh: 高强度的玩家间博弈、胜负悬念以及“证明自己比别人更强”的欲望，能极大地激发我的斗志。
text.en: High-intensity PvP mind games, close outcomes, and proving I am better than others strongly fuel my competitive drive.

text.zh: 我喜欢和队友明确分工、语音配合，靠团队协作攻克单人难以完成的挑战。
text.en: I enjoy clear role division and voice coordination with teammates to overcome challenges too hard to clear solo.

text.zh: 在公会、联机小队或社区中帮助其他玩家、互换资源，会让我觉得游戏更有温度。
text.en: Helping other players and trading resources in a guild, squad, or community makes a game feel much warmer to me.

text.zh: 相比于一个人默默单机，我更享受和朋友一起开黑、分享喜悦的归属感。
text.en: Compared to playing silently alone, I prefer teaming up with friends and sharing the fun and sense of belonging.

description.zh: 偏好高速动作、强烈打击感与即时感官反馈带来的肾上腺素体验。
description.en: Driven by fast pacing, visceral impact, and high-energy sensory feedback.

description.zh: 偏好拆解复杂规则、观察环境线索并用逻辑推理求解最优方案。
description.en: Driven by dissecting system rules, pattern observation, and logical deduction.

description.zh: 从填满图鉴、完成全收集与获取稀有道具中获得强满足感。
description.en: Motivated by completing codex entries, achievements, and rare item sets.

description.zh: 享受揭开地图迷雾、寻找隐藏房间与自由探索未知区域的惊喜感。
description.en: Motivated by clearing fog of war, finding secrets, and open-ended exploration.

description.zh: 重视外观搭配、角色造型、建造创造与独一无二的个人风格表达。
description.en: Motivated by visual styling, building, and expressing a distinct identity.

description.zh: 注重世界观自洽、角色塑造、剧情沉浸与符合人物性格的分支抉择。
description.en: Motivated by worldbuilding, character empathy, and immersive narrative choices.

description.zh: 享受在有限资源与机会成本约束下进行精算取舍与高效周转。
description.en: Motivated by budgeting scarce resources, opportunity cost, and economy tuning.

description.zh: 习惯提前布局科技树、养成路线与长期局势，追求全局掌控感。
description.en: Motivated by multi-step foresight, progression roadmaps, and long-term control.

description.zh: 受明确阶段目标、进度条推进与解锁勋章节点后的成就感驱动。
description.en: Motivated by clear goals, progression bars, and stage-clear rewards.

description.zh: 热爱反复练习与失误复盘，以操作和意识成长而非数值碾压取胜。
description.en: Motivated by deliberate practice, post-fail review, and mechanical growth.

description.zh: 从击败对手、冲击排行榜与和他人比拼战绩中获得强烈斗志。
description.en: Motivated by beating rivals, leaderboard ranks, and direct score comparison.

description.zh: 享受团队分工协作、互助社交与和好友共同通关时的归属感。
description.en: Motivated by coordinated teamwork, helping others, and shared social play.
